note: Voluntary support channels for Novarah Interactives. A channel is shown as ACTIVE only when status is "verified", verifiedOn is set, and (for links) the https URL's host is in allowedHosts, or (for QR) qrImage points at a file under download/support/. Until the developer verifies a real destination, every channel stays inactive and no payment control is shown anywhere (site, game menu, About, Settings). Never put card or bank details in this file.
